name: Campingplatz Kupferschmiede
beschreibung: Campingplatz Kupferschmiede is located in Chieming directly on the Chiemsee, in the Bavarian Chiemgau near the border with Tirol and the federal state of Salzburg. The surroundings are characterized by the impressive mountain backdrop of the Kaisergebirge and the expansive lake landscape. The facilities include modern sanitary facilities, a kiosk, a restaurant, and well-developed pitches with electricity and water connections. The family-friendly and quiet atmosphere makes the site ideal for those seeking relaxation and nature lovers. The target audience is primarily couples, families, and water sports enthusiasts who use the direct lake access for swimming, sailing, or stand-up paddling. From here, day trips into the mountains of Tirol, to Salzburg, or to München are easily possible.
